description: Only implemented fields; runtime additionally validates origins, cross-field constraints, secret ownership and command-specific required secrets. Future catalog keys are rejected until implemented.

recovery_ttl_minutes.description: Lifetime in minutes of newly issued local-operator recovery codes.

setup_token_file.description: Absolute service-owned 0400/0600 UTF-8 file containing the setup token.

api_max_connections.description: Maximum connections in the API database pool.

migration_url_file.description: Absolute service-owned 0400/0600 UTF-8 file containing the separate migrator PostgreSQL URL.

url_file.description: Absolute service-owned 0400/0600 UTF-8 file containing the runtime PostgreSQL URL.

database_url_file.description: Absolute service-owned 0400/0600 file with the separate local-operator PostgreSQL URL; mount only for operator commands.

schema_version.description: Required in every selected TOML file. Only schema version 1 is implemented.

allowed_origins.description: Additional exact origins. The public origin is always included. Arrays replace rather than concatenate.

environment.description: production, development, or test. Development/test listen only on loopback unless local_container is explicitly enabled for development.

local_container.description: Default false. Development-only wildcard container listener with exclusively HTTP loopback origins. Publish host ports only on loopback; never enable for a directly exposed host service. Production HTTPS mode rejects this flag.

public_url.description: Explicit HTTPS origin; loopback HTTP only in development/test. No credentials, path, query, or fragment.

static_dir.description: Built frontend directory; production serving requires an absolute path. Development default is web/dist; migrations do not use it.

antivirus_required.description: Require a configured ClamAV scanner before any attachment becomes ready; no scanner reports not_scanned when optional.

backend.description: Only local immutable blob storage is implemented.

local_root.description: Explicit absolute existing service-owned mode-0700 directory, outside webroot and Git checkouts. Required for API and worker.

quarantine_ttl.description: Unlinked upload lifetime in seconds; expired bytes become eligible for fenced worker cleanup.

scanner_socket.description: Absolute ClamAV Unix socket; configured scanner failures retain quarantine for retry.

workspace_quota_bytes.description: Workspace quota including pending, quarantine and not-yet-collected deleted bytes.

database_url_file.description: Absolute service-owned 0400/0600 file with the restricted worker PostgreSQL URL; mount only in the worker.

lease_seconds.description: Lease per bounded batch; renewed by a new claim between batches, with a fencing token.

max_connections.description: Maximum worker pool connections; one batch executes at a time in this implementation.

poll_interval_ms.description: Idle discovery interval in milliseconds. No transaction is held while waiting.

title: OpenTrack implemented configuration schema v1
